quote: In sequence modeling, given a context prefix C = u 1 , . . . , u k from a dialog u 1 , . . . , u n , the task is to find the true utterance u k+1 among a set of randomly sampled future utterances.
For evaluation, we measure the rank of p(u k+1 |C) of all utterances in the test corpus at the same depth.

We evaluate the triple-encoder also in the short-term planning scenario on DailyDialog. As expected the extra contextualization helps on this task as shown in Table , most significantly on the Hits@5 metric.
